text:
anna: Quick sync — vendor wants a narrow window for the external assessment next Wed 09:00-15:00 UTC. Can we lock scope and RBAC change windows?
kevin: I can do RBAC temp grants. Need to know which roles the assessor requires (read-only vs read+list vs impersonate).
anna: They asked for: log-read, kms-decrypt-check, svc-account-list. Prefer ephemeral roles.
liyah: Ops note: ephemeral creds will be created via vault->STS with 4h TTL. Need approval for IAM change and key ACL exceptions.
paul: For KMS: we can create a EKM policy allowing decrypt only from assessor's principal for a timebound condition. Example policy snippet: 
```json
{
  \"Statement\": [{
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Principal\": {\"AWS\": \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-run\"},
    \"Action\": \"kms:Decrypt\",
    \"Resource\": \"*\",
    \"Condition\": {\"DateLessThan\": {\"aws:CurrentTime\": \"2025-05-14T15:00:00Z\"}}
  }]
}
```
kevin: That looks fine. We'll also add a CloudTrail condition to force key usage logs to a dedicated S3 prefix.
security-bot: Ticket SEC-2025-042 created for assessor access + evidence packaging (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2025-042) :lock: 
anna: Perfect. Who will own evidence uploads? We need readable proofs for retest.
liyah: Ops will upload logs to a presigned S3 bucket with 30d retention. Presigned link TTL=72h. We'll bake a checksum file and SHA256 manifest.
paul: Packaging checklist: 
- export CloudTrail slice for window
- export app logs (runnable shard IDs)
- capture kube audit logs
- KMS usage logs (as separate file)
- manifest + sha256sums
kevin: Quick RBAC rollback plan: 
1) Remove assessor role binding at 15:05 UTC
2) Revoke active STS tokens (force token revocation via vault)
3) Re-add standard role bindings if anything changed accidentally
Make sure oncall is paged if revoke fails.
anna: Add a canary test before end: verify assessor no longer able to list service accounts.
sam: Product sig: we need to ensure no PII leaves. Confirm logs are sanitized for user identifiers.
paul: We'll run a grep redaction step before upload: 
```bash
sed -E 's/(user_id|email)\":\s*\"[^\"]+\"/\"\\1\":\"REDACTED\"/g' *.log > cleaned/
```
kevin: Also enable extra audit retention for 90 days in case retest is delayed. Ops cost accepted?
liyah: finance ok for temporary 90d extra retention for this engagement. Just toggle lifecycle rule.
anna: Timeline recap: 
- RBAC changes live Wed 09:00 UTC
- Evidence window Wed 09:00-15:00 UTC (collect continuously)
- Rollback + token revoke by 15:10 UTC
- Evidence upload complete by 18:00 UTC to presigned bucket
- Retest candidate slots: next Tue/Thu mornings, will confirm by EOD Mon
kevin: One more tech Q: do assessors need service-account impersonation to query metadata? If so we must use IAM conditions limiting access to ops-runner host.
paul: They requested metadata read for some clusters. We'll provide a scoped robot role and IP restrict via condition.
security-bot: Reminder: run the vuln whitelist scanner pre-window (SEC-WHITELIST-2025 v2).
anna: Action items — anna to approve RBAC PR, kevin to create KMS timebound policy, liyah to prepare presigned upload bucket + lifecycle, paul to prepare packaging scripts, sam to confirm PII redaction requirements with vendor.
kevin: I'll post the RBAC PR in #eng-releases and ping oncall for a 10m rollback dry-run tomorrow.
paul: I'll attach a sample evidence manifest to the ticket (SEC-2025-042).
anna: Thanks. If anything unexpected: page eng-oncall and tag me. :white_check_mark:
